_about: Epictetus in English (Arrian's Discourses and the Encheiridion), translator per title. Complete: George Long (1877, raw IA), P. E. Matheson (Oxford, 1916, 2 vols., raw IA; English only), Thomas Wentworth Higginson (1865; 1890 printing, 2 vols., raw IA). Clean Gutenberg: Long's Selection (1890), Crossley's Golden Sayings, Rolleston's Teaching. The Adler shelf's epictetus-discourses is labelled 'The Discourses, tr. P.E. Matheson' there, but its PG 45109 is Higginson's Enchiridion alone; Matheson's Discourses are on this shelf. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.

epictetus-long-selection: A Selection from the Discourses of Epictetus with the Encheiridion
epictetus-crossley-golden-sayings: The Golden Sayings of Epictetus, with the Hymn of Cleanthes

epictetus-long-discourses-1877: The Discourses of Epictetus, with the Encheiridion and Fragments (1877)
epictetus-matheson-1916-v1: Epictetus: the Discourses and Manual, vol. 1 (Oxford, 1916)
epictetus-matheson-1916-v2: Epictetus: the Discourses and Manual, vol. 2 (Oxford, 1916)
epictetus-higginson-works-v1: The Works of Epictetus: Discourses, Enchiridion and Fragments, vol. 1 (1890 printing)
epictetus-higginson-works-v2: The Works of Epictetus, vol. 2 (1890 printing)
epictetus-carter: All the Works of Epictetus, which are now Extant (Dublin, 1759)
